recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot studio portrait of a male figure with a textured hairstyle and mustache, wearing dark clothing against a dark, slightly vignetted background. The composition is framed by stylized, interlocking custom lettering in the upper left and secondary sans-serif text blocks.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast subject-to-background separation using rim lighting
Interlocking relationship between large display type and the subject's head
Diagonal text alignment echoing the subject's shoulder line
Warm skin tones contrasting against a cool, dark charcoal environment
coreInvariants: Deep black background with subtle texture
Low-key lighting with soft highlights on the face and hair
Interlocking letterforms with extended descenders and ascenders

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, waist-up, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes and mustache, positioned in the upper-middle third.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large custom lettering top-left, moves to the subject's face, follows the diagonal line of the secondary text down the left side, and settles on the hands/belt area.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy negative space in the upper right and lower corners to balance the dense text on the left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal/black background and clothing providing a neutral base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm, saturated skin tones (ochre and sienna).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for all typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white text and black background; moderate saturation in the subject's skin.

letterConstructionRules: Extended vertical strokes that cross other letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: O characters that nest within the curves of adjacent letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Custom interlocking display type paired with a clean, functional geometric sans-serif for secondary info.

preserve: Interlocking nature of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric basis with potential for ligatures and tight kerning.
Clean geometric skeleton for secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a man with a 1980s curly afro and mustache, wearing a black open-collar shirt and a textured white belt. The lighting is soft and focused on the face, with the background being a dark, textured charcoal grey. The subject is centered and looking directly at the camera.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, custom interlocking white title in the top left corner using monolinear strokes. Add secondary white sans-serif text below it, tilted at a 15-degree angle. Add a small text block in the top right corner underlined by a thin white rule.

verificationChecks: Is the main title interlocking without losing legibility?
Is the secondary text tilted correctly?
Is the lighting on the subject's face soft but high-contrast against the background?
Are all text elements pure white?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and song titles
Exact facial features of the specific individual

mustAchieve: Balanced distribution of text and subject

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the diagonal text doesn't obscure the face
Verify the white belt provides a strong horizontal anchor
Confirm the background remains dark and atmospheric
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Interlocking Monolinear Display Type + Diagonal Secondary Sans-Serif + Low-Key Lighting
